correctness.rationale: For arbitrary centers, the y=b/2 circle forces sqrt(r²-b²/4)+r>=a/2 when r>=b/2, giving r>=R. Two half-diagonal sites cover by strict concavity of arc half-widths. Equality on the critical circle and neighboring fibers fixes the pair, including the square case. Strict fiber concavity fixes the complete farthest set, and the density derivative factors as (t²-3)(t²+1)/t⁴. Exact rational contacts and 9801 checks corroborate, never substitute for, proof.
